scenes.text: Have you ever heard of a massive steel ship being grabbed by an invisible, ghostly hand in the middle of the ocean, completely frozen by a terrifying phenomenon sailors call dead water?
Your heavy ship engines could be running at absolute maximum power, yet your vessel will not move a single inch forward, almost as if dragged down by an ancient, angry sea monster.
This bizarre ocean mystery actually happens when a light layer of fresh melting water floats directly on top of much deeper, denser salt water, creating an invisible, treacherous boundary.
As your boat tries to sail forward, it generates massive underwater waves between these two layers that completely drain your energy, so tell me in the comments, would you panic?

meta.title: The Ocean's Invisible Ghost That Traps Huge Ships #shorts
